scope: Vietnam terrestrial mobile numbers (10 national digits, leading 0). Lists allocated number blocks only: a block says the number FORMAT is in an allocated mobile range, never that the subscriber exists, is active, or is still on that operator (number portability is allowed).
matching: A national number (0 + 9 digits) is allocated when it starts with any listed prefix. A prefix may have 3 or more digits when only part of a 3-digit range is allocated; prefixes must not overlap.

verification.note: The 3-digit mobile network codes below were reconciled on 2026-10-24 against secondary publications only (press and operator pages). The regulator's own allocation text (Cuc Vien thong / Bo Khoa hoc va Cong nghe, Quy hoach kho so vien thong) could not be retrieved from the build environment (egress blocked), so no 4+ digit block could be confirmed or ruled out. Before release an operator of this repository must compare this list with the official allocation and record the document number and date below; edit only this file and run `node scripts/gen-vn-mobile-prefixes.mjs`.
